title: Disputes Desk Reference Card: Dispute Window, Decision Time, Leak and Meter Test Terms by Utility Program
content:
# Disputes Desk Reference Card — Utility Services Program Figures

## Dispute timing

| Program | Calendar days after a line's bill date within which it may be disputed | Business days within which a dispute is decided |
|---|---|---|
| Essentials Utility Plan | 60 | 10 |
| Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan | 60 | 10 |
| Submetered Water Plan | 60 | 10 |
| Submetered Water & Gas Plan | 60 | 10 |
| Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan | 60 | 10 |
| All-Inclusive Utility Package | 60 | 10 |

## Leak adjustment figures

| Program | Leak adjustments available within the trailing 365 days | Share of the excess usage charge credited | Usage must reach this multiple of average usage to qualify as a leak | Calendar days after the disputed bill date within which the leak must have been repaired by work order |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Essentials Utility Plan | 0 | 0% | 0.00 | 0 |
| Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan | 0 | 0% | 0.00 | 0 |
| Submetered Water Plan | 1 | 50% | 2.00 | 30 |
| Submetered Water & Gas Plan | 1 | 50% | 2.00 | 30 |
| Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan | 1 | 50% | 2.00 | 30 |
| All-Inclusive Utility Package | 1 | 50% | 2.00 | 30 |

## Meter test figures

| Program | Fee for a resident-requested meter test that finds the meter within tolerance | Maximum over-registration still treated as accurate |
|---|---|---|
| Essentials Utility Plan | $0.00 | 0% |
| Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan | $0.00 | 0% |
| Submetered Water Plan | $50.00 | 2% |
| Submetered Water & Gas Plan | $50.00 | 2% |
| Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan | $50.00 | 2% |
| All-Inclusive Utility Package | $50.00 | 2% |

## Card notes

- The dispute window is 60 calendar days and the decision time 10 business days on every program.
- On the four submetered and package programs: one leak adjustment within the trailing 365 days, 50% of the excess usage charge, a 2.00 multiple of average usage, a 30-day repair window, a $50.00 meter test fee and a 2% tolerance.
- The Essentials Utility Plan and the Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan carry zero for every leak and meter test figure.
